title: ModelCard
description: Output of `model describe` — the model's fields (with kind, scale, declared bounds: numeric min/max, string minLength/maxLength/pattern, and enum-domain, each where applicable), groups (with repeatability), and declared locales. An agent's map of a model without reading raw DM-JSON.

locales.description: the model's declared locale codes, e.g. en_US

kind.description: value-kind: STRING | NUMBER | BOOLEAN | CONFIRM | DATE | ENUMERATION | CUSTOM | …

scale.description: decimal scale; present for NUMBER fields only

min.description: declared inclusive lower bound (minimum); present for a NUMBER field that declares one

max.description: declared inclusive upper bound (maximum); present for a NUMBER field that declares one

minLength.description: declared minimum string length; present for a STRING field that declares one

maxLength.description: declared maximum string length; present for a STRING field that declares one

pattern.description: declared regex pattern; present for a STRING field that declares one

values.description: allowed stored values; present for ENUMERATION fields only

repeatable.description: whether the group repeats (rules over it iterate)

maxRepetitions.description: the maximum number of rows; present only for a repeatable group
